$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-orientation-45-nonquadrant.xml (Rule 10, D-030). Orientation=45 - INSIDE OrientationType's 0..359 facet and NOT a multiple of 90. The value is legal and must be carried verbatim; nothing may round it to a quadrant, because a rotation is a physical fact about how the substrate sits and rounding it would silently mis-state the substrate's position. OriginLocation and AxisDirection are absent, so their XSD defaults apply and this fixture isolates Orientation alone.
